summary.name: HopToDesk
summary.one_liner: HopToDesk is a free, open-source remote desktop and remote support tool with end-to-end encrypted sessions, plus an optional paid Dashboard for fleet management.
use_cases: remote technical support for family or customers
accessing your own computer from another device
unattended access to office or home machines
managed IT support for multiple client devices
transferring files during a remote session
monitoring and managing a fleet of computers
summary.what_it_does: HopToDesk provides screen sharing, remote control, file transfer and live chat between computers. The page states that all traffic, including screen sharing, chats and file transfers, is end-to-end encrypted. It works across Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS and Raspberry Pi, and the page says it connects without router or firewall port forwarding. The free client works portably, with an optional Install step for background service and pre-logon access. An optional Dashboard adds real-time device monitoring, a help desk with ticketing, session and audit reporting, remote command execution and custom-branded client generation.
notable: Free and open source for personal and commercial use with no time limits, with source on GitLab
End-to-end encrypted sessions, with the page stating HopToDesk cannot see screens or files
Portable app that runs without installation; optional install for unattended access across reboots
Optional Dashboard with monitoring, help desk, session reporting and white-label clients
caveats: Dashboard fleet management, team features and Business plan tiers are paid beyond the free tier
Full Windows admin capabilities and pre-logon or unattended access require installing the app as a service
HopToDesk does not yet hold its own independent SOC 2 or ISO certification, according to the page
Some Dashboard features such as SLA tracking, audit trail and CSV export are listed only for Business plans
